def equation(t, A, params):
    st=np.sqrt(t); sA=np.sqrt(A); lA=np.log(A)
    return (params[0]*st + params[1]*st*sA + params[2]*st*A + params[3]*st*A*lA

            + params[7]*A + params[8]*A**2 + params[9]*sA)
